summary: Split the design record into short nested docs and merge in the ldd design
riskReason: Two records are merged and one is deleted, so a decision could be dropped by accident.

rules.text: docs/README.md is the index and holds 'Where we left off'; each area gets a folder; files stay near 40 lines
every decision in docs/design.md, including those 1.7 writes, lands in exactly one nested doc, with its date
#3's decisions Q1 to Q13 are recorded, and #1's Q13 is marked superseded by #3's Q3 and Q13

the ldd design goes into a team-phase section as the target: coordinator, forge adapters, the agent kit, claims, passkey approvals, conventions, and the stack, except what #3 dropped (agent-submitted review items, Ldd-Work, git notes, SHAs in plans) and what it deferred to #4 (the store and the runtime)
ideas only the ldd design had and #3 didn't drop are carried into the solo-phase docs where they apply, such as the conventions matcher and research and decision records on steps
CLAUDE.md points to docs/README.md instead of docs/design.md, and keeps its other rules
docs/design.md is removed; ~/repos/personal/ldd/docs is deleted only after the human confirms the merged record

evidence: a checklist that maps every decision in docs/design.md and every ldd doc to its new location, reviewed by the human
no nested doc is much longer than 40 lines
